name: Scripts
description: Your own commands, run when albums come into the library, when it changes, every so often, when Melody starts, or by hand

settings.label: For each new album
settings.help: Run once for each album new to the library, once it is whole. {} is its folder; MELODY_ALBUM_FOLDER, _ARTIST, _TITLE and _DATE say it too.

settings.label: When the library changed
settings.help: Run once the library has been still for half a minute after a change -- a scan, a write, a move.

settings.label: Every so often
settings.help: Run every so many minutes, as set below, while Melody runs.

settings.label: By hand
settings.help: Run from Workspace › Run › Run my command.
